ownership_and_deletion_contracts.requirement: Canonical server-bound source identity; model cannot choose viewer_id/partition; anonymous/untrusted relay claims do not grant personal memory.
Separate actual personal inputs and one shared public playback; retries do not duplicate accepted sources or preferences.
Per-owner recall/proposals, verified quotations, existing context budgets and original memory validation/maintenance.
Invalidate dependent contexts/summaries/jobs across partitions; preserve unrelated viewers own inputs/memory and actual game effects.
Durable canonical deletion outbox and idempotent per-store projection; do not claim atomic transactions across independent databases.
Cancel affected model/media requests with real barriers; preserve truthful technical playback completion history.
Replay deletion before readiness after crash/restore; old replays cannot rehydrate deleted data; distinguish new input and selected/full-account scope.
Minimal opaque deletion ledger without erased text; legacy ownership coverage gaps remain explicit until resolved.

ownership_and_deletion_contracts.requirement: Canonical server-bound source identity; model cannot choose viewer_id/partition; anonymous/untrusted relay claims do not grant personal memory.
Separate actual personal inputs and one shared public playback; retries do not duplicate accepted sources or preferences.
Per-owner recall/proposals, verified quotations, existing context budgets and original memory validation/maintenance.
Invalidate dependent contexts/summaries/jobs across partitions; preserve unrelated viewers own inputs/memory and actual game effects.
Durable canonical deletion outbox and idempotent per-store projection; do not claim atomic transactions across independent databases.
Cancel affected model/media requests with real barriers; preserve truthful technical playback completion history.
Replay deletion before readiness after crash/restore; old replays cannot rehydrate deleted data; distinguish new input and selected/full-account scope.
Minimal opaque deletion ledger without erased text; legacy ownership coverage gaps remain explicit until resolved.
